paragraphs: Ellucian sells administrative software to colleges and universities, covering the student lifecycle alongside finance and human capital management. The catalog is organized around student information systems, human capital management, and finance and operations.

The student product is presented as covering the whole lifecycle, from first inquiry through graduation. Recruiting and admissions work covers early engagement with prospective students, the application itself, and cost transparency. The financial aid side runs the cycle from eligibility through to the release of funds. Aid staff are meant to stay current with FISAP, IPEDS, and Institutional Methodology requirements. Retention features address graduation rates and advising workflows.

Ellucian states that it has more than fifty years in higher education and helps nearly 3,000 institutions and over 21 million students. The company also describes flexible pathways meant to connect learners with workforce opportunities. A user conference is announced on the site, with a call for session proposals open.

quote.text: With more than 50 years in higher education, Ellucian helps nearly 3,000 institutions improve outcomes for more than 21 million students.
